moderate.name: Steady Regional Monsoon Rain
moderate.description: Uniform regional monsoon precipitation with ramp-up and ramp-down over 120 minutes.

heavy.name: Convective Thunderstorm Cell
heavy.description: Intense convective thunderstorm peaking at 35 mm/hr centered over topographic depression [cell 9, 184].

extreme.name: Deep Depression / Cyclone Rainband
extreme.description: Severe moving squall band traveling NW to SE at 20 km/h with 65 mm/hr peak intensity.

cloudburst.name: Localized Urban Cloudburst
cloudburst.description: Extreme flash-flood cloudburst delivering 120 mm/hr over a 500m radius around cell [9, 184] for 35 minutes.
